personal_info.name: Priya Nair
personal_info.summary: Mechanical design engineer with two years in product development for industrial equipment. Works across CAD modelling, FEA and design for manufacturability.

experience.title: Mechanical Design Engineer
responsibilities: Modelled sheet-metal and machined assemblies in SolidWorks for industrial heat-exchanger units
Ran structural and thermal FEA in ANSYS to size brackets, cutting material use 12% without losing safety margin
Applied GD&T to production drawings and led tolerance-stack reviews with the manufacturing team
Coordinated with vendors on CNC machining and sheet-metal fabrication to resolve DFM issues before release

projects.name: Compact Heat Exchanger Redesign
description: Redesigned a plate-fin heat exchanger for a 20% smaller footprint at equal thermal duty
Validated the design with CFD, then confirmed against a physical prototype
